query: What MRP or multilevel model specifications and example formulas are recommended to integrate calibration weights and cluster structure for national inference?

response.query: What MRP or multilevel model specifications and example formulas are recommended to integrate calibration weights and cluster structure for national inference?
response.answer: For multilevel models integrating calibration weights and cluster structure, use the lme4 package in R with the lmer function, specifying weights and nesting levels. Example formula: lmer(outcome ~ predictors + (1|cluster)).

Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have showcased impressive code generation capabilities, primarily evaluated through language-to-code benchmarks. In this paper, we explore alternative way of leveraging Large Language Model (LLM) generated feedback to address the inherent limitation of using human-labeled data. Recent research in federated large language models (LLMs) has primarily focused on enabling clients to fine-tune their locally deployed homogeneous LLMs collaboratively or on transferring knowledge from server-based LLMs to small language models (SLMs) at downstream clients. Our analysis demonstrates that this task is highly challenging, with large language models (LLMs) yielding unsatisfactory performance. In this paper, we propose a data augmentation method via lightweight large language model (LLM) generation and tree hybridization.
